cases.name: branch removed → removed nodes
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const old = [{fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"B",file:"b.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}]; const now = [{fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}]; const r = diffTraces(old,now); return r.removed.length >= 1

cases.name: fork A→B→C to A→B→D
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const old = [{fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"B",file:"b.ts",line:2,children:[{fn:"C",file:"c.ts",line:3,children:[]}]}]}]; const now = [{fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"B",file:"b.ts",line:2,children:[{fn:"D",file:"d.ts",line:4,children:[]}]}]}]; const r = diffTraces(old,now); return r.forked.length >= 1

cases.name: empty old tree
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const r = diffTraces([],[{fn:"X",file:"x.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); return r.added.length >= 1

cases.name: large vs small perf
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const big = Array.from({length:100},(_,i)=>({fn:"f"+i,file:"f.ts",line:i,children:[]})); const t0=Date.now(); diffTraces([big[0]],big); return (Date.now()-t0)<1000

cases.name: same fn diff file
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const r = diffTraces([{fn:"init",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}],[{fn:"init",file:"b.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); return r.added.length===1 && r.removed.length===1

cases.name: circular ref no hang
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const a={fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}; const b={fn:"B",file:"b.ts",line:2,children:[a]}; a.children=[b]; return diffTraces([a],[{fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}])!==null

cases.name: null fields no crash
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const r = diffTraces([{fn:null,file:undefined,line:0,children:[]}],[{fn:"X",file:"x.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); return r.added.length>=0

cases.name: different roots all swap
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const r = diffTraces([{fn:"Old",file:"old.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"OC",file:"o.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}],[{fn:"New",file:"new.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"NC",file:"n.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}]); return r.removed.length>=2 && r.added.length>=2 && r.forked.length===0

cases.name: identical trees no diff
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const tree = [{fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"B",file:"b.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}]; const r = diffTraces(tree,tree); return r.added.length===0 && r.removed.length===0 && r.forked.length===0

cases.name: new leaf added
cases.execute: const {diffTraces} = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const old = [{fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}]; const now = [{fn:"A",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"B",file:"b.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}]; const r = diffTraces(old,now); return r.added.length===1 && r.added[0].fn==="B" && r.added[0].file==="b.ts"

cases.name: CHK-006: nodeKey includes line number
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const old = [{fn:"foo",file:"a.ts",line:10,children:[]},{fn:"foo",file:"a.ts",line:20,children:[]}]; const nw = [{fn:"foo",file:"a.ts",line:10,children:[]},{fn:"foo",file:"a.ts",line:30,children:[]}]; const diff = m.diffTraces(old,nw); return diff.removed.length===1 && diff.removed[0].line===20 && diff.added.length===1 && diff.added[0].line===30

cases.name: CHK-006: same fn different lines not merged
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const old = [{fn:"bar",file:"b.ts",line:5,children:[{fn:"x",file:"c.ts",line:1,children:[]}]},{fn:"bar",file:"b.ts",line:15,children:[{fn:"y",file:"c.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}]; const nw = [{fn:"bar",file:"b.ts",line:5,children:[{fn:"x",file:"c.ts",line:1,children:[]}]},{fn:"bar",file:"b.ts",line:15,children:[{fn:"z",file:"c.ts",line:3,children:[]}]}]; const diff = m.diffTraces(old,nw); return diff.forked.length===1 && diff.forked[0].line===15

cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-diff.js"); const t = [{fn:"a",file:"x.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"b",file:"y.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}]; const diff = m.diffTraces(t,t); return diff.added.length===0 && diff.removed.length===0 && diff.forked.length===0

cases.name: CHK-006: line=0 nodeKey dedup
